import csv
import shutil

path = "data/order_summary.csv"
backup = "data/order_summary.backup.csv"
order_id = "ORD-6C71B1"

shutil.copyfile(path, backup)

with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as file:
    reader = csv.DictReader(file)
    fieldnames = reader.fieldnames
    rows = list(reader)
    dialect = reader.dialect

matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("order_id") == order_id]

if len(matches) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one matching order, found {len(matches)}")

if matches[0].get("status") != "cancelled":
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected current status 'cancelled', found {matches[0].get('status')!r}"
    )

matches[0]["status"] = "confirmed"

with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as file:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(file, fieldnames=fieldnames, dialect=dialect)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)

print(f"Updated {order_id}: cancelled → confirmed")
print(f"Backup saved to {backup}")

with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    lines = file.readlines()

header = lines[0].rstrip("\r\n").split(",")
order_column = header.index("order_id")
status_column = header.index("status")

matches = 0
updated = []

for line in lines[1:]:
    ending = "\r\n" if line.endswith("\r\n") else "\n" if line.endswith("\n") else ""
    fields = line.rstrip("\r\n").split(",")

    if fields[order_column] == "ORD-6C71B1":
        matches += 1
        if fields[status_column] != "cancelled":
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Expected status 'cancelled', found " + repr(fields[status_column])
            )
        fields[status_column] = "confirmed"
        line = ",".join(fields) + ending

    updated.append(line)

if matches != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one matching order, found " + str(matches))

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write(lines[0])
    file.writelines(updated)

print("Updated ORD-6C71B1: cancelled -> confirmed")
